translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Jesús purkwaled-akar kannan tullesgujad
Tegin Tumigin polegu, wagal ampa aku-takle, María-Magdalena uanzhe nad. Tegin María-Magdalena uanzhe omosgu, taknatapmal, akwa-tummad-uan-ya-chaktijiid pato oniral-chii.

Tegin María takchagu akwa-tummad-uan-ya-chaktijiid oniral-chii, kannan ilgwen abarmakalzhun, Simón-Pedroje tegin Jesús-e-chapin-pul-pilaledzhe. Wedin an. Tegin María anmalga chogalzhun: —Imi tulemal uan-akar anmal-Tummad-mui chesmal. Tenal anmal wichulmal, pia Tummad-mui-tigzhamal.
Tegin Pedro anpak mes uanzhe nadzhun.
Tegin anmal nadgu aga mecha abarmadmal. Tenal antin pul Pedroga abarma-choggu, al an-inzhel uanzhe omos.
Tegin an uan-yabal nuekwa takegal an tullu imasgu, an takchado, mol-Jesús-ebirmajadbi pukwa. Tenal an uan-yabal kwen togzhajul.
Tegin Simón-Pedro, an-cholbal nonigu, ilgwen uan-yabal togzha. Tenal Simón-Pedro takchamodo, mol-Jesús-ebirmajadbi pukwamo.
Tegin Simón-Pedro takchabal, mol-Jesús-mui-e-nono-ebirmajad pis pukwa, tenal nuekwa pipisal pukwa.
Tegin antin uan-yabal kep togzhamo. Tegin an takchagu Jesús-mui maichul, kep an penzhul-kunoni, Jesús kannan tulles.
Tenal teun anmal ampa aku-itomal, Pab-kartagin nermakal mai, Jesúsdin keg-chulgu purkwaled-akar kannan tulleged-wilub.
Tegin kep anmal kannan negzhe almalbal.
Jesús María-Magdalenaga sanal nononikid
Imi teun takalgu, María-Magdalena uan-magarbal ampa pogwis-pes.

Tegin María poed-abalgin nuekwa uan-yabal takegal tullu imasgu, takal, angel-walbo mol-chibugan yoyo-pukwamal. Tenal angel-walgwen Jesús-megwijad nag-tukubal chii, tegin angel-walgwen Jesús-nono-megwijadzhik chimo.
Tegin angelmal Maríaje ekichialmal: —¿Puna, ibiga pe po-wede? Tegin María angelmalga chogal: —Imi tulemal anpi-Tummad-e-mui chesmal. Tenal an wichul tulemal pia an-Tummad-tigzhamal.
Tegidgin María-Magdalena akpiridgu, takal Jesús e-abir kwichi. Tenal María wichul wedin Jesús.

Tegin Jesús Maríaga chogal: —¿Puna, ibiga pe po-wede? ¿Pe toa ami-ade? Tenal María ebinzhe, we tulede, nagnu-taked. Al María Jesúsga chogal: —An-ai, pe we tule-mui-chejal, anka pe chogoma, pia pe ches, an akne tignegal.
Tegin Jesús Maríaje kote: —¡María! Tegidgin María-Magdalena Jesúszhik akpiridgu, sapejul Hebreo-kakagin kote, chogal: —¡Rabuni! (Wedin choglege, tule-oturdaked.)

Tegin Jesús Maríaga chogal: —María, melle pe an-kama. An ampayo Pab Tummadzhe nakwe. Imidin an pei, pe ne, an-kwenadganzhe. Tegin pe an-kwennadganga chogo: “Antin, an Pab Tummadzhe nakwene. Tenal Pab Tummad, an-pab tegin pe-pabmo. Tenal Pab Tummad an-Pab-Tummadga mai tegin pe-Pab-Tummadga maimo.”
Tegin María-Magdalena, Jesús-e-chapinganzhe nadzhun. Tegin María Jesús-e-chapinganga pél palchogzhajun, ede Pab-Jesús-takcha. Tegin María palchogzhabal, Jesús ega pél chunmajad.
Jesús aga e-chapinganga nononikid

Imi teun ampa te Tumigin, mutik Jesús-e-chapingan Judio-tummagan-tobedbal neg-yabal pukwamal. Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan wanagakkin piir chowal mezhismal melle tulemal kin togmalgal. Tegidgin Jesús e-chapingan-abalgin nononigu, e-chapinganga chogal: —Anná, tegidde, ¿pemalde, igi kumal?

Tegin Jesús teob chogzhagu, e-chapinganga e-chunkal-eskorogin-pioklejad tegin e-tikal-eyurulejad oyos e-chapingan wisgal, ede chunchunnad Jesús. Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan Pab-Jesús-takchagu, weligwal pesmalzhun.
Tegin Jesús kannan aga e-chapinganga chogalbal: —Pe aga ulubgin akalzhul-itomalalen, nabirin. Imi an-Pab an-palmialidyob, an pemal-palminemalmo Pab-kaka-nuegan palchoggal.
Tegidgin Jesús aga e-chapingan-agnus. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Imisgin pe Pab-Purpa-Nued-abingemalo.

Tenal pe Pab-Purpa-Nued-abingajadbal, pe igal-nika, meke-ibi-tulega pe chogzhal, ‘Pe iskued pelgus,’ we tule-e-iskued pelguenab. Tegin pe meke-ibi-tulega chogzhal, ‘Pe iskued pelguszhul,’ we tule ampa iskuedgin kudii, e-iskued ampa pelgujul.
Imi Jesús aga e-chapinganga nononigusgu, teun Tomás Jesús-e-chapingan-pimaladbak chijul. Tenal Tomás Jesús-e-chapingan-walambe-kakabogwad-walgwenmo. Tegin tulemal Tomás-pimalbal, Tarbo-Mimmilejad.

Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan-pimalad Tomásga chogzhamal, emalde Jesús-takchamal. Tegin Tomás Jesús-kannan-tullejad itosgu, e-pakamaladga chogal: —Imi we tule-pe-anka-chogmalad e-chunkalgin eskorog-ya-chiid an takchulil, tegin an ko-yojulil, tegin an e-tikal-eyurulejadgin an chunkal-yojulbalil, an kwen ibzhaojul, wedin Jesús.

Tegin Jesús-kannan-tullejad-tumigwengin Jesús-e-chapingan ampa te neggin ampagunonimalbal. Tenal teun Tomás e-pakamaladbak mes kujimo. Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan wanagakkin piir chowal mezhismalbal, melle tulemal kin toggal. Tenal teun Jesús kannan e-chapingan-abalgin nononibal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Anná, tegidde, ¿pemalde, igi kumal?

Tegin Jesús Tomásga chogal: —Imi pe takto, an-chunkal. Imisgin pe ko yodado. Tegin pe an-tikal-eyurulejadgin pe chunkal yobaldo. Tomás, pe melle ankin penguma, pe ankin ibzhema, antin Jesús-chunchunnaddo.
Tegin kep Tomás Jesúsga chogalzhun: —Pedin, pe an-Tummad tegin pe an-Pab-Tummadbal.
Tegin Jesús Tomásga chogalbal: —Imi pe sanal an-takchadbal pe ankin penzhul-kunoni. Tegin an chogbaldo, tule an-takchajulidbal, yabli ankin ibzheel, ib-nued we tulega kus.
Juan iti-karta nermajad oyogal Jesúsde Pab-Machi-chunchunnad
Imi Jesús e-chapingan-wagin ichejul immal-taktijulmalad-pimalad imas. Tenal an iti-kartagin, Jesús pél immal-taktijulmalad an kwen chogzhajul-kus.

Tenal antin iti-kartagin an kwénna-kwénna Jesús-immal-taktijulmalad wis nermas, pemalga pakal-pud oyogal, Jesús, Pab-Machi-chunchunnad, wedin Cristo-Pab-Tummad-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-tule. Al pe Jesúsgin ibzhenonikil, pe ilagwen-nadgu tullego.
